memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh's gate-mode promotions (ORPHAN_GATE_MODE, INDEX_TRUTH_GATE_MODE, SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE) all follow the same shape: severity branching lives in one shared *_report() helper function per gate family, called from every Rule check site, so promoting advisory->hard is always just a one-line default-value flip plus a comment update -- never a change to the check logic itself. When researching/verifying such a promotion, run the actual script with the target mode forced via env var override BEFORE editing, to empirically confirm zero findings corpus-wide rather than trusting task-completion summaries alone.
